evidence: Phenotype **features** are also negative: on the core homogeneous GNN, base 0.2406 / 0.2179 versus pheno16 0.1875 / 0.1902.
observation: Rather than noisy edges, 16, 32 and 64-dimensional SVD embeddings of ancestor-closed HPO terms were added as node features on the core graph. All three hurt the ten-seed homogeneous GraphSAGE relative to the base features, and only 657 of 9,512 nodes carry any phenotype annotation.
subject: F-61
title: HPO context as node features also fails on the homogeneous GNN
